explanation: The statement is about the library's own graph-canonisation data structures: `Part` (with its `cst`/`cen`/`pos`/`lab` fields), the library's `Refines n q p` predicate (Progress.lean:41), and `individualize` (Algorithm.lean:499). Grepping Mathlib for `Refines`, `individuali[sz]` and related graph-colouring/partition-refinement names turned up nothing; Mathlib has no individualisation/refinement notion of this shape. The proof relies on library lemmas `individualize_cst_getElemD` and `IndivData.cst_eq`, which are also library-local, so no Mathlib declaration states or yields this result.
